verdict.rationale: CIPO's own trademarks page publishes a forecasted examination wait time (about 8.2 months for an October 2026 filing), so the office does publish processing times for trademark applications itself. That is the only transaction type with evidence; the pack shows no published timelines for patents, industrial designs, copyright, renewals or other trademark transactions. Missing for 10: processing times for patents, industrial designs, copyright and other trademark transactions, how often the figures are updated, and any independent corroboration.
